generated_output_label: Computed only from the supplied CSV; unavailable metrics are omitted from available_metrics and explained in unavailable_metrics. No simulated results.
input_assumptions: Rows must cover a single coherent observation period or non-overlapping additive records. Count and currency columns are summed.
Do not combine overlapping App Store and RevenueCat exports in one file; use one source per invocation to avoid double counting.
Snapshot subscriber counts must already be aggregated for the observation period. Retention requires matching retained-user and cohort-size columns.
Payback uses the observation-window approximation acquisition_spend / net_revenue * observation_days; it is not cohort lifetime value or a forecast.

metric_formulas.revenue_per_install: revenue / downloads using net_revenue when present, gross_revenue - refunds when both are present, or gross_revenue otherwise; calculation_context records the basis
metric_formulas.refund_rate: abs(refunds) / gross_revenue when both columns exist and gross_revenue > 0
metric_formulas.payback_days: acquisition_spend / net_revenue * observation_days; net_revenue requires a net/proceeds column or gross_revenue and refunds

rules: STOP when any available configured stop threshold is crossed.
SCALE only when no stop rule fires, at least minimum_scale_signals decision signals are available, and every available decision signal meets its scale threshold.
ITERATE when decision signals exist but scale and stop conditions are not met.
INSUFFICIENT_DATA when no configured decision signal is available.
